prospective_design: 80 treatments on four previously unused explicitly labeled groups plus one known reference; source files, selection, parameters, seeds and queue frozen before native MIP calls. No model replacement or post-result retuning.
metadata_disagreement: neos-3083784-nive original MPS has 12123 matrix nonzeros, compared with 11583 in the archived instance description. Original input was retained and checked coefficient by coefficient.
posthoc_cost_audit: After observing numeric zero-cost deliveries with positive exact feasible witnesses, all 16 nive assignments were frozen for a separate 2-second exact LP primal/dual audit. The positive witness alone was not treated as proof that cost zero was impossible. Only equal primal/dual bounds certify a fixed-pattern minimum. This was not a prospective endpoint of the 80-treatment design.
posthoc_farkas_verification: Four saved dual rays from those same 16 LP calls were subsequently verified against original rows and bounds without additional optimization calls. The original missing-rational-primal-or-dual outcomes remain in place.
numeric_and_exact_costs: The frozen controller retains the minimum numerically budget-compliant cost. It may retain zero instead of an exact positive-cost repair. Source records are not rewritten. Derived CSVs distinguish nominal delivery cost and best exact feasible witness per run; the separate cost audit supplies pattern minima. Dot-product evaluation itself is correct.
budget_scope: Experimental algebraic row budgets are 1e-4 max(1,abs(rhs)), continuous bound budgets 1e-4, integer domains exact. These are not physical or operational tolerances. Large big-M right-hand sides allow large original algebraic residuals.
timing_overruns: All 80 assigned cycles are retained. Four HiGHS/nive Base or Base-tight cycles took 23.1368 to 23.5724 seconds, exceeding the 20-second reference. Their export/import/exact-preservation check took 6.9620 to 7.4131 seconds and solver calls about 15.004 to 15.006 seconds. The solver limit was computed before that import stage and was not reduced afterward. This is an implementation limitation of cycle-time control, not a real-time guarantee or an exclusion criterion.
timing_scope: Shared model acquisition, preparation and original reference-witness acquisition are separate from treatment cycles. Auxiliary certificate files are charged within their stages. Final delivered NPZ persistence is separately timed. The subsequent 16 LP audit costs 5.1313 seconds in total and is not attributed to the previously evaluated algorithm.
representation: Certificates use the canonical binary64 model. An independent literal check finds every original decimal coefficient, RHS, cost and bound in nive exactly representable in binary64. Other models have explicit decimal-to-binary64 rounding counts and no ideal-decimal certificate claim.
scope: Fixed-pattern LP optimality or infeasibility is not a global MILP lower bound, optimum or infeasibility proof. Two seeds, four new groups and one known reference do not establish population superiority. Exact weak duality, Farkas and repair are not claimed as new mathematics. OMS v1.3.5 remains unchanged.
